trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Provide application ID and state intent to get a discount.
steps.text: ஹலோ, நான் கார்த்திக் பேசுறேன். என் application ID APP-2004.

steps.purpose: Greet the user and ask how to help.
steps.text: வணக்கம் கார்த்திக். நான் உங்களுக்கு எப்படி உதவ முடியும்?

steps.purpose: Request a discount quickly.
steps.text: எனக்கு fees-ல கொஞ்சம் discount வேணும். என்னால அவ்ளோ கட்ட முடியாது. சீக்கிரமா பண்ணி குடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Ask for verification factors.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா செக் பண்றேன். verification-க்காக உங்க date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: 12th May 1990. கொஞ்சம் fast-ஆ செக் பண்ணுங்க, எனக்கு time இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return verification success.
Acknowledge verification and inform that fee details are being checked.
steps.text: நன்றி. இப்போ உங்க fee details செக் பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிஷம்.

steps.purpose: Lookup the fee account details.
Return fee account details.
Inform the user about the current balance, scholarship, and active instalment plan.
steps.text: கார்த்திக், உங்க account-ல ஏற்கெனவே 10% scholarship apply ஆகியிருக்கு. இப்போ balance due 320000 இருக்கு. உங்க instalment plan-உம் active-ஆ தான் இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge but insist on a waiver.
steps.text: அது தெரியும், ஆனா எனக்கு இன்னும் கொஞ்சம் waiver வேணும். ஏதாச்சும் பண்ண முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Deny the waiver request as per business rules.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும், ஏற்கெனவே scholarship கொடுத்தாச்சு. புதுசா எந்த discount அல்லது waiver-உம் தர முடியாது.

steps.purpose: Ask for alternative options like a new EMI plan.
steps.text: அப்படியா? என்னால அவ்ளோ பெரிய amount கட்ட முடியாது. பழைய plan-ஐ மாத்தி புதுசா EMI போட முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Offer available instalment options.
steps.text: ஆமாம், பழைய plan-ஐ மாத்தி புதுசா 2, 3, அல்லது 4 instalments-ஆ கட்டலாம். உங்களுக்கு எத்தனை instalments வேணும்?

steps.purpose: Choose 4 instalments with an STT error.
Clarify the number of instalments due to STT error.
Confirm 4 instalments.
steps.text: ஆமா, 4 instalments தான். சீக்கிரம் setup பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Set up the new instalment plan.
Return the new instalment plan details.
Inform the user of the successful plan setup and the per-instalment amount.
steps.text: உங்க instalment plan active ஆகிடுச்சு. Plan ID PLN-998. நீங்க ஒரு instalment-க்கு 80000 கட்டணும்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call.
steps.text: Ok, clear. நான் அப்புறம் pay பண்றேன். Bye.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.

variant_findings.reason: The agent passes the 'reference_id' returned by verify_customer_identity into lookup_fee_account as 'application_id', and subsequently passes the 'application_id' from lookup_fee_account into setup_instalment_plan. Given the constraints of the provided tool schemas (where application_id is the only valid input for subsequent tools), this successfully demonstrates result-to-input propagation.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Multi-Tool Execution Coordination > Result-to-Input Propagation

In e11, the agent accurately relays the 10% scholarship, 320000 balance due, and active instalment status from e10. In e21, the agent provides the exact Plan ID (PLN-998) and per-instalment amount (80000) returned in e20.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

The agent correctly uses all required tools, adheres to the business rules by denying a fee waiver, and accurately grounds its responses in the tool outputs. The persona of a hurried professional is executed perfectly with short, direct turns that push the agent for quick action. The STT error is plausible and handled smoothly. The use of Tamil mixed with English in the specified script mode is natural and accurate.
